problem.title: Number of Distinct Paths in a DAG
problem.problemStatement: Given a Directed Acyclic Graph and two vertices S and T, determine the number of distinct paths from S to T.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N, M, S, and T. • Next M lines contain directed edges.
problem.output: Print the total number of distinct paths.
